about_the_game:
Break out the balloons and grab the confetti - it's PARTY TIME! This colorful set for RPG Maker includes balloons, games, decorations, food and everything else you need for a festive occasion. Whether you prefer chips or charcuterie, these party assets deliver a good time...just add to your existing maps!


Contents:

* Tables with plain, glitter and striped tablecloths
* Confetti autotiles
* Balloons - letters, numbers, punctuation, groups of balloons. All include animations to give maps a little more life!
* Cakes and cupcakes - 6 styles of cakes (with candle animations) and a cupcake with candle.
* Games - Knock down bottles (with animated baseball and two bottle animations), balloon pop (with popped balloon animation and dart), pin the tail on the donkey (with tail events in several positions), pinatas (with striking, pinata swaying, and candy falling animations) and horseshoes, with horseshoe animation. Also includes ribbons and trophies for the winners!
* For a more fair-like ambiance, food trucks and trailers! Includes 3 trailer/truck styles (with animations) a pickup to pull the trailers if desired, three styles of stationary food stalls, an umbrella-covered cart, and "open" stationary versions of the trailer/trucks.
* Gifts galore! Includes many sizes of packages and bags, with and without two different styles of bows. Also includes opened gift boxes.
* Food - cheese puffs, chips, pretzels, popcorn (with machine), punch, pizza, candy of many types, cotton candy (with machine) candy displays, fondue, chocolate fountain (with animation), 4 charcuterie boards with wine, and more!
* Serving items - plates, cups, bowls, etc
* Pre-built tablescapes - ready to go!
* Decor items - decorated chairs, ribbons and displays with messages (and also blanks, so you can add your own), bows, hanging decorations, large spiral ribbons, buntings, streamers, backdrops, balloon arch, canopies and more!

All decor objects come in red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, pink and white/black.


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
